clauses.quote: either party may demand bargaining pertaining to State or Federal legislation.
clauses.notes: Mutual right; applies equally to district and association.

clauses.quote: The District may re-open negotiations in accordance with 7.6.2.1.
The Association may re-open negotiations in accordance with 7.6.3.2.
Other sections of the CBA may be re-opened only by mutual consent except where specifically permitted by the CBA itself or required by law.
clauses.notes: Procedural constraint requiring mutual consent for contract amendment; restricts unilateral changes by either party.

clauses.quote: No later than May 1, 2007 each party shall present proposals for a successor agreement.
clauses.notes: Mutual deadline for successor agreement proposals.
